description:
List assets approved by Mangrove, including supported stablecoins and tokens. Approval is independent of risk assessment. Unassessed risk scores are null; do not interpret them as zero or infer regulatory approval. Returns available market metadata and risk scores.

[Access: pay 0.001 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
